messages.content: [Royal Lytham & St Annes Golf Club] Royal Lytham & St Annes Golf Club in Lytham St Annes, Lancashire, England, is one of the courses in the Open Championship rotation. The Women's British Open has also been played on the course five times: once prior to being designated a major championship by the LPGA Tour, and four times since. It most recently hosted the Women's Open in 2026. | other articles: 2026 Women's British Open, Women's British Open

[2026 Women's British Open] The 2026 AIG Women's Open was played from 30 July to 2 August at the Royal Lytham & St Annes Golf Club Golf Links in Lancashire. It was the 50th Women's British Open, the 26th as a major championship on the LPGA Tour, and the seventh championship held under a sponsorship agreement with AIG. Shiho Kuwaki won on the second hole of a sudden-death playoff with Esther Henseleit to claim her first major title. | other articles: Women's British Open, 2026 in sports
